literal: Good meaning well having understood even if they say, the poor's words' meaning failing will suffer.
translation: Even if the poor understand profound truths well and speak them, the meaning of their words will fail to carry weight.
modern: நல்ல கருத்துகளைத் தெளிவாக உணர்ந்து சொன்னாலும், வறுமையுற்றவர்களின் சொற்கள் மற்றவர்களால் ஏற்கப்படாமல் வீணாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights how poverty undermines a person's voice in society. The phrase 'நற்பொருள் நன்குணர்ந்து சொல்லினும்' means that even if a poor person grasps good, profound ideas and articulates them well. 'நல்கூர்ந்தார் சொற்பொருள் சோர்வு படும்' concludes that the substance of their words will still fall flat or be ignored. The word 'சோர்வு' (failing or slipping) effectively captures how their wisdom loses its impact simply because of their impoverished state.
